title: 中国药价：仅美国一半，凭什么是我们？
speaker: Unidentified Jefferies Healthcare Analyst

segments.en: maybe starting from day one from the launch, they still want to achieve at least 50% of the growth margin, right?
segments.zh: 从上市第一天起，他们仍希望实现至少50%的毛利水平，对吧？

segments.en: So that means that we assume that for a generic opposite drug, the monthly cost in China will be around 30 U.S. dollar per month.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们假设一款仿制药在中国的月费用大约为30美元。

segments.en: So, nowadays, for example, if I lay lay, their monthly pricing in China is 100 U.S. dollar per month. I think that is already quite affordable, like a monthly cost.
segments.zh: 如今，比如某款药在中国的月定价为100美元，我认为这个月费用已经相当可负担。

segments.en: So versus the U.S. and UK, a lot of places, they are still like 40, 100 U.S. dollar per month. So that's the story here. It keeps coming back to this, right?
segments.zh: 相比之下，美国和英国等许多地方的月费用仍在40到100美元。这就是关键点，总是绕不开这个话题。
